scope: Dedicated local managed Codex executor only; no owner profile or Codex Cloud
prerequisites: A dedicated machine or execution environment with its own system/MDM requirements. CODEX_HOME isolates only user state and does not relocate /etc/codex or enterprise policy.

Distribute rendered requirements.toml through the supported managed layer and config.toml to the dedicated user layer. Keep adapter scripts, Python and the core executable admin-owned outside the writable work tree. Render paths and actual QA TLS edge origin explicitly.
Retain the exact inspected binary pin, or obtain controller qualification for an inspected compatible dedicated binary. Do not change Ivan's app, model, effort, permissions or configuration.

Use shared core login and server-authorized CLI machine enrollment for the intended work-item seat. Distinct Wave1 slots belong only to the named Claude Code adapter, Codex adapter and optional release rehearsal session.

Supply immutable served E1/edge build references and actual QA origins, with gateway/provider credential custody and network proxy operation proven by their owners. Provider credentials must remain outside executor tools.
installed_readback: configRequirements/read returns non-null effective requirements from the dedicated system/managed layer; retain its actual loader provenance and requirements artifact digest.

config/read retains the complete helm provider at edge /v1, wire_api responses and executable auth args[token], required helm MCP at edge /mcp with shared http_headers_helper, workspace-write and enabled hooks/network proxy.

hooks/list reports the three expected managed command definitions, their actual managed provenance and isManaged=true: synchronous PreToolUse deny, asynchronous PreToolUse observe and asynchronous PostToolUse observe. No user trusted_hash substitutes for managed authority.

Actual effective requirements pin the provider/MCP identity, allow_managed_hooks_only policy, forbidden exec prefixes, permitted sandbox modes and exclusive network domains. Native readback must use the installed field names; unsupported schema fails instead of being silently dropped.
execution_acceptance: Qualify the production CLI inner workspace-write path on the dedicated compatible environment. The previously challenged outer Seatbelt/app-server externalSandbox path establishes only its bounded local scope.
Actual allowed tool executes, raw tools do not dispatch, required MCP connects, and original Pre/Post hook stdin reaches shared core. CP ingestion readback proves only observed-only persistence.
Challenge actual network/file policy, including permitted gateway operation and denied direct provider/GitHub/Linear access. Static requirements and helper exit status do not prove enforcement.

Signed D24 audience/client/existing episode/TTL admission and native stopped-token/retained-attempt drain need source-owned issuer/gateway/runtime evidence. Adapters never parse tokens or change native clocks.

T100 and native D8 require the actual two managed adapters on one retained UUID, stop before successor checkout, UNKNOWN reconciliation, same original attempt on lost-response retry, and no duplicate provider dispatch.
